reason: At packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:53-77, a single try/catch wraps the whole `for` loop of awaited `client.request` cancel calls (lines 56-73) and the `Promise.all(workflowRemindersToDelete)` at line 74.
